AccessResponse.description:
What the caller's key unlocks: everything ("full"), reading and asking only
("read", API_READ_KEY), or everything because no key is configured ("open").
AccessResponse.title: AccessResponse

CitationResponse.description: Citation metadata returned with an answer.
CitationResponse.title: CitationResponse

CitationSpanResponse.description: The passage of a cited chunk an answer's claim rests on (see api/citations.py).
CitationSpanResponse.title: CitationSpanResponse

DocumentChunkResponse.description: One stored chunk of a document, for the source viewer.
DocumentChunkResponse.title: DocumentChunkResponse

DocumentContentResponse.description: A document reconstructed from its stored chunks, in ordinal order.
DocumentContentResponse.title: DocumentContentResponse

DocumentDeleteResponse.description: Result of removing an indexed document's chunks.
DocumentDeleteResponse.title: DocumentDeleteResponse

DocumentIngestResponse.description: Completed document ingestion result (also embedded in a finished job status).
DocumentIngestResponse.title: DocumentIngestResponse

DocumentJobAcceptedResponse.description: Response returned immediately when an upload is accepted for background ingestion.
DocumentJobAcceptedResponse.title: DocumentJobAcceptedResponse

DocumentJobListResponse.description:
A workspace's queued and running ingest jobs, oldest first: uploads from any
client, the watched folder, a bulk re-index or a restore.
DocumentJobListResponse.title: DocumentJobListResponse

DocumentJobStatusResponse.description: Current status of a background ingestion job.
DocumentJobStatusResponse.title: DocumentJobStatusResponse

DocumentListResponse.description: Filenames currently indexed, for per-document query filtering.
DocumentListResponse.title: DocumentListResponse

DocumentRefreshResponse.description: POST /documents/{f}/refresh when the source said nothing changed (304).
DocumentRefreshResponse.title: DocumentRefreshResponse

DocumentReindexAllResponse.description: Result of re-indexing every stale document that has a stored original.
DocumentReindexAllResponse.title: DocumentReindexAllResponse

DocumentTagsRequest.description: Replace a document's tags. An empty list removes them all.
DocumentTagsRequest.title: DocumentTagsRequest

DocumentVersionsResponse.description: Earlier versions of a document's original (RAW_DOCUMENT_VERSIONS), newest first.
DocumentVersionsResponse.title: DocumentVersionsResponse

FeedbackItemResponse.description: One recorded rating, as stored — the denormalized row, not a trace_id join.
FeedbackItemResponse.title: FeedbackItemResponse

FeedbackRequest.description:
A thumbs up/down rating of an assistant answer, optionally one citation.

Denormalized rather than trace_id-only: the client already holds the question,
answer, and cited filenames for the turn being rated, and TraceStore's ring
buffer can evict trace_id before this ever reaches durable storage.
FeedbackRequest.title: FeedbackRequest

FeedbackResponse.description: Confirmation that a feedback rating was recorded.
FeedbackResponse.title: FeedbackResponse

HistoryMessageRequest.description: One prior turn of client-sent conversation history.
HistoryMessageRequest.title: HistoryMessageRequest

ImportResponse.description: What POST /import did with each document in the backup.
ImportResponse.title: ImportResponse

PromptMessageResponse.description: One message from the exact prompt sent to the generation provider.
PromptMessageResponse.title: PromptMessageResponse

PublicConfigResponse.description: Non-secret runtime configuration exposed to the UI.
PublicConfigResponse.title: PublicConfigResponse

SearchRequest.description: Retrieval without an answer: the passages a question would be answered from.
SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest

SearchResultResponse.description: One passage, best first, with the scores that ranked it.
SearchResultResponse.title: SearchResultResponse

SummaryRequest.description:
Summarize one whole document, compare two, or write one brief across several
(POST /questions/summary).
SummaryRequest.title: SummaryRequest

SummaryResponse.description: A summary or comparison: an answer, plus how much of the documents it read.
SummaryResponse.title: SummaryResponse

TimingsResponse.description: Per-stage wall-clock latency, in milliseconds, for one answer.
TimingsResponse.title: TimingsResponse

TraceCandidateResponse.description: One fused retrieval candidate's journey through rerank and context selection.
TraceCandidateResponse.title: TraceCandidateResponse

TraceConfigResponse.description: Effective per-request settings a trace was generated under.
TraceConfigResponse.title: TraceConfigResponse

TraceDetailResponse.description: Full per-query debug trace: candidates, the exact prompt, and timings.
TraceDetailResponse.title: TraceDetailResponse

TraceSummaryResponse.description: One row of the trace list — enough to pick a trace without fetching it.
TraceSummaryResponse.title: TraceSummaryResponse

UrlIngestRequest.description: Index a document fetched from a URL (POST /documents/from-url).
UrlIngestRequest.title: UrlIngestRequest

UsageResponse.description:
Tokens the provider reported for an answer's LLM calls: the condense, query
expansion, the answer, its citation retry, a summary's notes, and (on POST
/questions) the follow-ups; a stream's `done` comes before its follow-ups.
UsageResponse.title: UsageResponse

WatchRetry.description: A watched file waiting to be tried again after a failure.
WatchRetry.title: WatchRetry

WatchStatusResponse.description: The watched folder (WATCH_DIR) as of the watcher's last pass.
WatchStatusResponse.title: WatchStatusResponse

WorkspaceCreateRequest.description: Create a workspace (POST /workspaces); see api/workspaces.py for the name rule.
WorkspaceCreateRequest.title: WorkspaceCreateRequest

WorkspaceListResponse.description: The workspaces besides the default one (which has no name and is always there).
WorkspaceListResponse.title: WorkspaceListResponse

info.description: Self-hostable document Q&A API with hybrid retrieval and citations.
info.title: DocRAG API

409.description: With stored originals, the name differs from an existing document's only by letter case or accents; or the collection was built for another embedding setup and still holds documents.
The remote server named the document after one already indexed (pass `filename` to replace it); or, with stored originals, the name differs from an existing document's only by letter case or accents.
A newer upload of the document was indexed after this delete was requested; it was kept.

200.description: Unchanged at the source (304); nothing was fetched.

schema.title: Response Refresh Document From Url Documents  Filename  Refresh Post

404.description: No such document, it wasn't fetched by URL, or URL ingest is off.

409.description: The document is already being indexed, originals aren't kept (RAW_DOCUMENT_DIR), or the index was built for another embedding setup.
The workspace still holds documents or originals.
